messages:
emma: Kickoff for the PLG launch — want to stitch launch posts + a short webinar into the free-credit funnel. Experiment idea: credit buckets (100 immediate vs 100 immediate + 400 conditioned on demo attendance). Also test two prompt template bundles (templates-lite vs templates-deep). Goal = higher 7-day active devs.

ryan: Agree. Keep the social creative focused on a single easy win (e.g., "ship a search assistant in 10 min"). Use webinar to demo the deep bundle.

chris: Routing thought: inbound traffic that comes from the launch posts gets routed to a lightweight signup flow with immediate credits shown. If they register for webinar, tag them as "attendee_elig" and lock bonus credits behind attendance webhook.

nina: I can do two email variants: Variant A emphasizes credits + quick templates, Variant B emphasizes webinar + deeper templates. We'll A/B subject lines too.

emma: Measurement: funnel steps = click -> signup -> RSVP -> attend -> claim -> first_api_call. Key metric = % making first API call within 48h.

ryan: For social cadence: Day 0 hero post (short video), Day 2 technical thread, Day 5 testimonial snapshot + webinar CTA. Use UTM params per creative.

chris: Small config snippet for infra/devex:
```
experiment_name: orbit_launch_2026
arms:
  - name: instant_only
    credits: 100
    templates: templates-lite
  - name: attendance_bonus
    credits: 100
    locked_bonus: 400
    templates: templates-deep
cohort_split: 50/50
webinar_track: single
```

nina: Webinar agenda: 5m why this matters, 15m live build with templates-lite, 15m show deeper templates for scaling + Q&A. We'll offer a recording and a 100-credit replay top-up for non-attendees.

emma: Creative copy notes: headline options: "Free credits to try LLM building" / "Ship your first LLM feature today". CTAs to test: "Start building" vs "Save my seat".

analytics-bot: Created tracking events: launch_click, signup, webinar_rsvp, webinar_attend, credits_claimed, first_api_call. Dashboard stub: https://dash.redwood.ai/exp/orbit_launch_2026

ryan: Bench blurb for announcement: show one simple stat for devs to set expectations e.g., "Starter templates: ~100 tokens to generate a search response, ~80ms p50 on hosted." Keep technical but accessible.

chris: Ops checklist: ensure credit ledger idempotency, attendance webhook retries, unlock flow validated. Also flag to prevent double-awarding for users who sign up multiple times.

nina: Timing: assets by Friday, registration page up Monday, webinar Weds 11am PT. Will coordinate with ops-bot for calendar and reminders.

emma: Great. Owners: copy/nina, social/ryan, devex/chris, analytics/analytics-bot, ops/ops-bot. Next quick sync Tuesday.

ops-bot: Registration page created: https://events.redwood.ai/orbit?utm=orbit_launch_2026. Calendar invite scheduled Weds 11:00 PT. Reminder cadence set: -24h, -1h, +5m post start.

chris: One more: add a lightweight benchmark card on the registration page with example p50 latency and example token cost for the two template bundles so prospects can see TCO differences upfront.

emma: Love that. Makes the post more concrete. I'll draft copy and ping for approvals.

nina: I'll draft the two subject lines and social captions, will drop in the campaign doc. :email:

ryan: Thanks all. I'll queue the hero video storyboard. :clapper:

emma: Thanks team — moving to execution.
